title: Two eggs on toast with avo and tomato
steps: Cook the eggs your way: poach for 3 to 4 minutes in gently simmering water, boil for 7 to 9 minutes, or fry in a hot non-stick pan with no oil until the whites are set.
Mash the avo onto the toast with a pinch of salt.
Top with the eggs and sliced tomato and finish with black pepper.
